Meet the Japanese stoat, a carnivorous creature living in the subalpine areas of central and northern Honshu. These high-altitude animals are members of the weasel family and can be found at elevations of over 1,200 meters. ✨ These wildly cute critters have incredible coats, which go from chestnut brown with a white underbelly in summer to nearly totally white in winter — only the tips of their tails have color, a bold black. ❄️ But don't be fooled by their cuddly exterior — Japanese stoats are feisty, with a fierce temperament and enough power to take down larger birds and wild rabbits when hungry. 🐇😮Most of the time, however, they stick to hunting field mice and insects. 🐁 🐛🪲 When exploring Oze's subalpine zones, keep your ears open for a high-pitched "kii!" coming from the bushes. If you're lucky enough to spot a stoat, you can get a "stoat discovery card" at the Oze Yamanoh

caption: ricardolorytravels 41 followers View profile ricardolorytravels 12 posts · 41 followers View more on Instagram Like Comment Share Save 8 likes ricardolorytravels BUDGET TRAVEL GUIDE TO VIETNAM ✈️ Follow @ricardolorytravels for more travel & food picks 🩵 Vietnam is one of the best destinations to visit when you want maximum purchasing power and incredible culinary experiences on a budget! ✨ All prices are in USD! 🏨 Accommodation: $5 to $15/night per person. Hostel dorm beds start around $5–8/night, while budget private rooms and guest houses run $10–20+. I stayed in a central private room for $14/night ($7/person). 🥭 Food: $1 to $3/meal. Vietnam’s world-class street-food meals commonly run around $1–2, while inexpensive sit-down meals can be around $3–6. 🚤 Activities: It’s possible to spend $0 on activities exploring Hanoi’s Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem Lake, and local markets. Cultural temples cost $0–2, a Water Puppet Show is ~$4, and day trips like Ha Long Bay cruises run $40–80+. I would recommend an activity & transit budget of about $20-100 depending on what you want to do. 🛵 Getting Around: You can get around via affordable buses, ferries, and sleeper trains between regions. The prices vary depending on where you are traveling from. ✈️ Flights: Flights to Southeast Asia can obviously be expensive depending on where you are flying from, which is why I recommend booking a longer trip to maximize your ticket value. caption: italian.passion and italyexplores Italy View profile italian.passion 11,459 posts · 591K followers View more on Instagram Like Comment Share Save 1,443 likes italian.passion @lorrainestraveltips is showing us places you can’t miss on your next trip to Italy! 🥰🇮🇹❤️ 💡5 things to avoid on your Italy trip, with helpful tips: 🚶‍♂️ Avoid Tourist Traps Stick to the well-known attractions but explore hidden gems away from the crowds for a more authentic experience. Avoid overpriced shops or restaurants around major landmarks like the Colosseum or Piazza San Marco. 🍝 Don’t Fall for Bad Food Avoid dining at places with menus in multiple languages or overly flashy signs. Opt for local trattorias or osterias where the locals eat for better quality and more authentic Italian cuisine. ⏰ Avoid Long Lines Skip the long waits at popular attractions like the Vatican Museums or Uffizi Gallery by booking tickets in advance or visiting during off-peak hours. 💸 Don’t Overpay for Souvenirs Steer clear of touristy shops selling overpriced souvenirs. Instead, visit local markets or artisan stores for unique and reasonably priced gifts. 🌧️ Don’t Ignore Weather Warnings Be prepared for sudden weather changes. Especially in summer, avoid outdoor activities during the hottest part of the day, and always carry a water bottle and sunscreen. caption: openbook.stories 1,167 followers View profile openbook.stories 76 posts · 1K followers View more on Instagram Like Comment Share Save openbook.stories The Portugal tips I wish someone had texted me before I landed. 🇵🇹 Lisbon is walkable, yes. Flat? Absolutely not. 😭 Public transportation will save you money, Sintra deserves a full day, Pena Palace is worth booking early, and keeping a little cash on you is still a good idea. But maybe the biggest one? Don’t plan every second. Some of the best parts of Portugal happen when you leave room to wander, take the side street, stop at the café, and let the day change a little. Giant sand dunes run straight into the ocean, creating breathtaking scenery and unique landscapes. The lagoon is 3.7km in length and 1km wide and is enveloped by sandy desert on its eastern side. It is a sweetwater lagoon that originates from groundwater rising from the foot of the dunes, flowing into the ocean. The lagoon, salt pans and the bird sanctuary, which form the Walvis Bay Wetlands, are rightly heralded as the single most important coastal wetlands of Southern Africa. It is one of five Ramsar sites in Namibia. Sandwich Harbour is an important ecological area and home to eight endangered species. Over 40 000 birds thrive in the lagoon environment.
